subtitle: Cells to Future Generations: One Framework, Many Domains

blocks.explanation: A second rendering of PoLPEST built around the infinity motif — Life Continues, Life Adapts, Life Flourishes, Future Generations. It restates PoL as the supreme foundational value driver and walks the same three parts: PoL as universal value driver, the altruistic gradient and biological valuation, and the synthesis matrix. Its conclusion traces one value across scales — cells survive, organisms stay healthy, communities cooperate, civilizations build culture, the planet sustains, future generations inherit — closing with the single filter question: does this maximize the probability that life continues, adapts, and flourishes into the future?
blocks.tts: PoLPEST across scales: from cell survival to future generations, one value driver — the perpetuation of life — filtering every domain.
